title: A headline price is not a total
context: Fictional budget-conscious university student planning a three-day leisure trip. All prices are USD per traveler for the whole trip unless a fact explicitly says otherwise. Travel times are one-way. Only the supplied descriptions count as evidence; no real destinations or prices are represented.

facts.text: Lodging and transport subtotal is $210; meal and activity costs are not supplied.
Total trip cost is $295, all expenses included.
Total trip cost is $340, all expenses included.

constraints: Total trip cost must be at most $300
initial.reasons: Juniper Point is only $210 so I am sure it fits.

advice.text: Juniper Point costs only $210 in total and is safely within budget.

constraints: Total trip cost must be at most $300
followups.reasons: I need meal and activity costs before deciding.
followups.reflection: I need meal and activity costs before deciding.
